messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a perf regression on canary for the paged-attn path after landing the kernel-selection fallback tweak. Token throughput drops ~18% under 8k sequence workloads.
jiang: ugh. which tweak exactly? the preference for fused-attn on medium seqs?
maria: yeah, the change that biases kernel-choice to fused when batch_size * seq_len < 2e6. Repro: run the benchmark on flashv2 models with pagehouse enabled.
sam: seeing increased page fault churn metrics on the KV pager during the same window. paging_iops spiked and evictions doubled.
ben: can you paste the benchmark command? I'll try it on a dedicated node.
maria: repro command: 
```
tools/bench/attn_bench --model flashv2-1.3b --seq 8192 --batch 1 --paged-kv=true --kernel-policy=canary
```
Output snippet (p99 latency): 42.3ms -> 50.0ms after canary. throughput 120k tok/s -> 98k tok/s.
jiang: interesting — fused path reduces compute per-token but increases KV cache working set because it keeps longer in-flight KV windows, so more pagehouse pressure. We probably moved the knee too far.
sam: logs from pager: 
```
[2025-03-02T14:22:11Z] pager: evict candidate count=1240 live_pages=3120 reclaim=980
[2025-03-02T14:22:11Z] pager: io_wait 12ms avg, queue_depth 8
```
ben: repro'd on clean node, confirmed similar regression. Heap pgcache resident set grows until aggressive eviction starts thrashing.
maria: quick profiling with perf showed more time in pagewalk and memcpy after the change. Flame summary: compute kernel time reduced by 10% but memcpy + pagewalk increased by ~30%.
jiang: hypothesis: kernel selection induced longer KV lifetimes for the same request mix, causing subpage locality loss. We should add a conservative cap: only pick fused when seq_len < 4096 OR batch-size > 2.
ben: can we add a runtime flag quickly to flip back? deploy-bot: deploy request queued: rollback-kernel-policy -> canary group (3 hosts). ETA 2m.
maria: in parallel, I pushed a telemetry probe to record (kernel_choice, seq_len, batch, kv_live_pages) per request. Hoping to get distribution tonight.
sam: for immediate mitigation, suggest throttling fused on paged-kv nodes: set KERNEL_PREF_FUSED=0 on pagehouse hosts. Also raise pager hysteresis to avoid reactive thrash.
jiang: agree. long-term: we should include a cost function in kernel selection that accounts for expected KV residency and eviction cost (est. bytes * expected_live_duration). See sketch below.
```
score_fused = cpu_time_gain - alpha * expected_kv_eviction_cost(seq_len, batch)
if score_fused > 0: choose fused
```
maria: thanks — I'll open a small RFC with telemetry results and a patch to add that cost term. For now applying deploy-bot rollback and pager hysteresis tweak.
ben: putting a small smoke test in CI to run a paged-attn scenario when kernel policy changes.
maria: :thumbsup: will post follow-ups once telemetry lands.
sam: keeping alert on paging_iops and p99.
deploy-bot: rollback-kernel-policy applied to canary group at 1713254368.
jiang: nice catch, thanks team.
